class.name: FmodLoggingSettings
class.brief_description: Debug logging configuration for the FMOD system.
class.description:
FmodLoggingSettings controls FMOD's internal debug output. Configure it in the FMOD section of Project Settings under the Logging category.
Use [member debug_level] to control verbosity and [member log_output] to choose where messages are written.

method.name: get_debug_level
method.description: Returns the current debug verbosity level as a [enum DebugLevel] value.

method.name: get_log_file_path
method.description: Returns the file path used when [member log_output] is set to [constant FMOD_DEBUG_MODE_FILE].

method.name: get_log_output
method.description: Returns the log output destination as an [code]FMOD_DEBUG_MODE[/code] value.

method.name: set_debug_level
method.description: Sets the debug verbosity level. Use a [enum DebugLevel] constant.

method.name: set_log_file_path
method.description: Sets the path of the log file. Only used when [member log_output] is [constant FMOD_DEBUG_MODE_FILE].

method.name: set_log_output
method.description: Sets the log output destination. Use an [code]FMOD_DEBUG_MODE[/code] constant.

members.member: Debug verbosity level. [code]0[/code] = inherit from Project Settings default; use [enum DebugLevel] constants for explicit values.
Path for the debug log file. Used when [member log_output] is [constant FMOD_DEBUG_MODE_FILE].
Where FMOD debug messages are written. Default is [constant FMOD_DEBUG_MODE_CALLBACK] ([code]1[/code]), which routes messages through Godot's output.

constants.constant: Log errors, warnings, and informational messages.
Log all FMOD debug output. Very verbose — use only for debugging.
Write debug output to the system console (stdout).
Route debug output through a callback. In this integration, messages are forwarded to Godot's output console.
Write debug output to a file specified by [member log_file_path].
